final: WITH step1 AS (SELECT a.player_id, p.death_country, SUM(a.g_1b - a.g_cf) AS total_diff FROM appearances AS a JOIN player AS p ON p.player_id = a.player_id WHERE p.death_country <> '' GROUP BY a.player_id, p.death_country), step2 AS (SELECT AVG(total_diff) AS avg_total_diff FROM step1), step3 AS (SELECT s1.total_diff, s1.total_diff - s2.avg_total_diff AS diff_from_avg FROM step1 AS s1 CROSS JOIN step2 AS s2 WHERE s1.total_diff > s2.avg_total_diff) SELECT SUM(total_diff), AVG(diff_from_avg) FROM step3
